detail.longDescription: I have a beginner exercise where I need to make a label that shows the input text, but in uppercase. I tried to create a function with the same name, before I realized setText was a built-in function. The current code just repeats the input text as each character is typed in, without upcasing. I have no idea how to make it work properly. import sys from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMainWindow, QLabel, QLineEdit, QVBoxLayout, QWidget class MainWindow(QMainWindow): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.setWindowTitle("ALL CAPS") layout = QVBoxLayout() self.input = QLineEdit() self.label = QLabel("") self.input.textChanged.connect(self.label.setText) layout.addWidget(self.input) layout.addWidget(self.label) widget = QWidget() widget.setLayout(layout) self.setCentralWidget(widget) app = QApplication(sys.argv) w = MainWindow() w.show() app.exec()
